title: Pin gateway to gpt-review-planner v1.3.0
description: Updates the immutable planner workflow pin and advertised capability so the gateway can accept planner v1.3.0 smoke tasks.

requirements.summary: Pin executable patch validation to the merged planner v1.3.0 baseline.
acceptance: AC-003: The canonical valid-manifest fixture uses the same immutable pin.
AC-004: A regression test locks the version and commit.

requirements.summary: Advertise the exact planner v1.3.0 capability in gateway control snapshots.
acceptance: AC-006: gatewayCapabilities does not include gpt-review-planner-v1.2.0.
AC-007: Existing protocol and multi-branch capabilities remain present.
AC-008: A regression test locks the advertised planner capability.

gates.name: Go formatting
gates.command: gofmt -w internal/app/app.go internal/app/app_test.go internal/task/model.go internal/task/model_test.go && test -z "$(gofmt -l .)"

gpt_static_checks_performed: Compared the current gateway immutable pin with the merged planner 1.3.0 baseline.
Prepared a five-file unified diff limited to pin constants, canonical fixture, capability publication, and regression tests.
Verified the task is compatible with the currently deployed planner v1.2.0 pin so the gateway can bootstrap itself.
gpt_runtime_checks_not_performed: Host gofmt, go vet, go test, and go build.
Live gateway pickup, isolated worktree execution, Airelay dispatch, evidence commit, and result publication.
Merge, reinstall, restart, or control snapshot refresh.
known_integration_risks: The deployed gateway continues to accept only planner v1.2.0 packs until this source task is reviewed, merged, installed, and restarted.
The planner project lacks a persisted resume_session_id, but the currently reachable free session is sufficient for the later smoke task while it remains active.
forbidden_deviations: Do not change taskbundle schemas, branch layout, execution policy, session configuration, or source repository paths.
Do not merge, install, restart the gateway, or modify rceman/typer outside normal result publication.
Do not change the target planner baseline or accept multiple mutable planner pins.
